CLUB SEEN, still widely called SEEN Beach Club Samui, is a 3,500 m² pool club for up to 2,000 people on Chaweng Beach, next door to the Avani Chaweng Samui Hotel & Beach Club. The beach club is open daily from 11:00 to 23:00, and on event nights the indoor UNSEEN Club Room carries on from 23:00. From 19 December 2026 to 27 March 2027 it is 18+ every day. The 2026–27 high season starts with a Season Opening on Saturday 26 December, followed by eight O Beach Ibiza Sundays from 27 December to 14 February 2027.

Map of SEEN Beach Club

The club sits on the sand on Chaweng's beachfront, entered from the Chaweng Beach Road side next to the Avani Chaweng hotel. Central Chaweng, with ARKbar, Soi Green Mango and the walking street by Chaweng Lake, is within walking distance or a short Grab ride.

What it's like

The club opened in 2022 with the Avani Chaweng hotel and relaunched in December 2025 as CLUB SEEN, with three spaces. SEEN Eatery serves lunch and early-evening food. The main stage and outdoor DJ booth run the afternoon-to-sunset party around two turquoise infinity pools and a sunken swim-up bar. UNSEEN Club Room is the smaller indoor room for late, deeper sets. The look is 1950s Palm Springs and Miami: white curves, geometric shapes and loud colour.

It is the biggest event venue on Samui. The 2025–26 season brought Defected, Glitterbox, ARTBAT, Nina Kraviz, Kölsch, Joseph Capriati and Claptone, and on 21 February 2026 it hosted the first Zamna "On The Beach" festival in Thailand. In April 2026 it entered the DJ Mag Top 100 Clubs list at number 52, the only Samui venue on the list.

On a weekday outside the big events it is a different place: a smart pool club with a DJ, sunbeds and lunch. The beach faces east, so there is no sunset over the sea. The light goes soft behind you at about 18:00.

Tickets, minimum spends and the rules

On ordinary days there is no entry ticket. Daybeds, sofas and tables are booked in two slots, 11:00–17:00 and 18:00–23:00, and the minimum spend is paid before you arrive. Unclaimed bookings can be released 30 minutes after the start time, and bookings are non-refundable. Avani Chaweng says simple tables and cocktail tables have no minimum spend, but beach beds and daybeds do.

Event days are ticketed, and the 2025–26 rules are worth knowing before you buy:

  • Main-event tickets cover the outdoor party, usually 14:00–23:00. The UNSEEN after-party from 23:00 needs a separate ticket.
  • Last entry depends on the ticket tier: 16:00 for early-bird tickets and 18:00 for regular tickets (23:30 for the after-party). Late arrivals can be refused or charged a 500 THB late fee.
  • Re-entry is allowed only until 19:30.
  • Tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable. If rain stops the party, they convert to food and drink credit.
  • Table packages are for the main event only. Check in by 20:00 or the table may be resold, and deposits are not refunded.
  • Bring photo ID: entry is 18+ at all events.

Good to know: the age rules have changed several times. Avani Chaweng says under-18s may visit the club until 19:00, while a July 2026 Minor Hotels release describes the club as 18+ daily. From 19 December 2026 to 27 March 2027 it is 18+ every day, so leave teenagers at the hotel in high season.

Food and drinks

SEEN Eatery serves a sharing menu with Tokyo and Latin influences, from 11:30 with last orders at 22:30. Earlier menus included tom yam pizza, tacos and sushi rolls. Avani Chaweng guests have breakfast here.

The club doesn't publish an à la carte price list, so we don't quote one. What is published: a 500++ THB ticket for a July 2026 event, table packages from 8,000++ THB, and O Beach tickets from 800 THB with no drinks included. "++" adds 10 % service and 7 % VAT, so 8,000++ becomes 9,416 THB. Budget for resort-level prices, above ARKbar and well above a Chaweng bar.

Tips

  • Book beds for event days well ahead. Headliner days and the O Beach Sundays can sell out in high season.
  • Arrive before your ticket's last-entry time. Early-bird tickets with a 16:00 cut-off are no use if you plan to turn up at sunset.
  • Pay in THB if a card machine offers to convert the amount.
  • Don't swim in the sea after drinking. Chaweng flies red flags on many days from October to December, and the pools are the safer swim.
  • November and early December are the rainiest months. A downpour can stop an outdoor party, and tickets then become drink credit, not refunds.
  • Never ride a scooter home. Pre-book a driver or use Grab, and expect taxi fares to rise after 22:00.

Who it suits, and who should go elsewhere

Go if you want an international DJ in a proper club setting without the boat to Koh Phangan, if you are a group happy to split a table package, or if you want a smart pool day in Chaweng with lunch and music.

Go elsewhere if you are travelling with children in high season (18+ from 19 December to 27 March), if you are on a tight budget (ARKbar has free entry and walk-in sunbeds from 300 THB minimum spend), or if you want a sunset over the sea. For that, go to the north-coast clubs such as Chi Samui in Bang Rak, or the west coast. All the options are compared in Koh Samui beach clubs.

Getting there

From most of Chaweng you can walk. From elsewhere, Grab is easiest, and it works well in Chaweng, Bophut and Lamai. Chaweng Beach Road is jammed from late afternoon, so allow extra time before a ticket cut-off.
